judgment.quote_A: Probability of drawing two balls of the same color = (6/20) + (1/10) = 1/4 + 1/20
judgment.quote_B: After drawing one blue ball, there are now 1 red ball and 1 blue ball left in the box
judgment.reason: Both answers are incomplete (cut off by length). Answer A correctly calculates the individual probabilities of drawing two red balls (6/20) and two blue balls (1/10) but makes arithmetic errors when adding them (incorrectly converting 6/20 to 1/4 and 1/10 to 1/20) and fails to state the final exact fraction. Answer B correctly calculates the probability of two red balls (3/10) but incorrectly states that after drawing one blue ball there is 1 red and 1 blue remaining (should be 3 red and 1 blue), leading to an incorrect probability of 1/3 for the second blue ball, and also fails to complete the calculation. Answer A is preferable because it correctly identifies both component probabilities.
